listings.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships - Art Scholarships
listings.funder_name: Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS)
listings.summary: Art scholarships are open to students wishing to pursue an initial Master's degree in an artistic field in Switzerland. This scholarship is available to students from a limited number of countries only.
listings.source_name: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI) - Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships

listings.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships - Research Scholarships
listings.funder_name: Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS)
listings.summary: These scholarships are available to postgraduate researchers in any discipline wishing to pursue research at any Swiss cantonal university, university of applied sciences, either of Switzerland's two federal institutes of technology (ETHZ or EPFL) or at one of the four research institutes within the ETH Domain (PSI, WSL, Empa, Eawag).
listings.source_name: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI) - Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
